summary: Required sync settings under catalog.providers.rhaap in the Helm values: orgs (one AAP organization only), sync.orgsUsersTeams.schedule.frequency (for example { minutes: 60 }) and sync.orgsUsersTeams.schedule.timeout (for example { minutes: 15 }).
questions: What settings are required for portal sync?
Can self-service automation portal sync more than one AAP organization?

answer_card.title: Required portal sync settings
answer_card.answer_md:
Under `catalog.providers.rhaap` in the Helm values file:

| Option | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orgs` | string | The **one** AAP organization to sync |
| `sync.orgsUsersTeams.schedule.frequency` | object | How often identity sync runs, e.g. `{ minutes: 60 }` |
| `sync.orgsUsersTeams.schedule.timeout` | object | Max duration before timeout, e.g. `{ minutes: 15 }` |
